title: MLOPS↔BACK-001: Fleet Model Status → Registry/Rollout Reconciliation
description: Backend reports fleet-wide model version distribution and rollback events to MLOps; MLOps supplies rollout-strategy parameters and authorizes stage promotion. Grounded in MLOPS_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.9 (Backend/Cloud Engineer).

desired_model_version.description: Version MLOps wants set per cohort.

rollout_parameters.description: MLOps→Backend: parameters for Backend to set desired model version per cohort.

fleet_distribution_status.description: Backend→MLOps: fleet-wide model version distribution snapshot.

devices_stuck_non_active_over_1h.description: Count of devices in a non-ACTIVE state for more than 1 hour.

stage_promotion_notification.description: Backend→MLOps when observation-period health metrics meet promotion criteria; MLOps authorizes within 1 business hour.

x-macp.tier_rationale: OTA-strategy control plane: desired-version reconciliation and rollback gating (permanent HITL gate). Routine snapshot exchange is Tier-3; promotion/rollback decisions are Tier-1.
x-macp.cadence: SLA_FROM_EVENT (distribution snapshot every 4h active / 24h observation; stage promotion response within 1 business hour; rollback notification within 5 minutes of event; registry stage update within 30 minutes)
confirm_conditions: rollout_parameters present with valid canary_percentage and rollback_target_version
fleet_distribution_status counts are internally consistent (version_counts sum vs. fleet size)
rollback notifications delivered within the 5-minute SLA
stage promotion authorized only when health_metrics_met = true
reject_conditions: rollback_target_version not a previously-ACTIVE registered version
snapshot_timestamp stale beyond the cadence SLA (ESC-SLA)
counter_conditions: devices_stuck_non_active_over_1h is non-zero and rising — request hold on next-stage promotion pending investigation
rollback_reason_codes include an unrecognized code — request code reconciliation
